scope: Independent selected-host occupancy and bootstrap terminal-history design review only
requirementsReviewed: P02-GATE-AC07 specific bounded diagnostics, concurrency/crashedowner convergence, no volume deletion/shadowstack/otheruser attachment
P02-GATE-AC08 same actual NATS status/freshness, unavailable services never healthy
LOCAL-01 L01 lease/current reinspection rather than metadata/PID/timeout authority; L02 original10s frontend/60s owner; L04 actual full scoped NATS status

findings.issue: Publication moment is unspecified. Run normally lives beyond Bootstrap completion, so writing only in its final defer delays success/failure history and cannot supersede older failure promptly.
findings.required: Concrete Run-owned worker/factory publishes the actual returned Bootstrap outcome once its exact bootstrap call has returned, with joined completion semantics and separately observed cleanup state; Run exit updates only genuine cleanup facts without replacing original operation outcome.

findings.issue: Expected prior generation, stale policy and next-ensure precedence are not a complete protocol. Last terminal failure can be confused with a newer admitted attempt or rollback.
findings.required: Define exact cold attempt/generation semantics, no history-based startup control, explicit supersession/unknown-current representation and bounded TTL. Status invocation nonce is not a new cold generation.

findings.issue: NATS-absent later status cannot be an authenticated NATS L04 reply. Local owner trust is a separate bootstrap-only authority boundary.
findings.required: Fresh independently enrolled OS-owner/profile permission gates historical diagnostic read. Label source/history explicitly; current instance/hubs/work/readiness remain unknown until actual NATS observation.

findings.issue: Atomic overwrite and handling of unknown or mismatched existing artifact are unspecified. A stale file must not block compatible ensure or be overwritten without authority.
findings.required: Held private-root descriptor + no-follow/UID/mode/ACL/nlink checks, bounded closed record and exact prior inode/digest/generation compare under actual service lease. Unknown artifact retained/refused replacement, diagnostic unavailable, genuine ensure proceeds through ordinary current admission.

findings.issue: Publishing after a timed-out operation may have no remaining original budget; join alone does not prove child/socket/resource cleanup complete.
findings.required: Reserve publication and existing cleanup inside the original total without widening deadlines. Record terminal failure separately from cleanup incomplete/unknown; retain exact typed Session/dialer/servicelease handles and surface publisher failures safely.

findings.issue: Windows helper image/trust/enrollment/platform mapping is new infrastructure. Docker executable trust and a WSL listener are insufficient.
findings.required: Explicit separately qualified installed helper image/Windows owner+ACL/signature/digest/host mapping with fixed arguments/result; exact socket/process closure/oneWait. Native Linux/macOS probes only where selected engine port really maps to that host.

findings.issue: An early clear probe cannot reserve a port, and moving acceptance behind an arbitrarily contended lock can break pending10s.
findings.required: Use early read-only diagnosis where budget permits, repeat at actual locked cold StartOwned boundary and after failure to classify only genuine observation. Preserve entered pending via NATS/exact creator pipe, and label missing/unknown control honestly.

simplestCompleteRevision: Keep current one-frame<=4096+EOF/read-once/CLOEXEC receipt unchanged. It remains exact newly created process correlation and accepted request only, never current instance readiness.

Add one private selected-host occupancy adapter to bootstrap infrastructure. Derive endpoint only from full admitted profile/Compose/current engine mapping. Verified compatible running owned broker bypasses foreign-port rejection; absent/stopped cold flow observes only the selected actual host. Successful OS listener observation or completed TCP connect with no application bytes may produce a momentary listener diagnostic; bind failure/access/reservation/timeout/unknown helper result never means occupied.

Use remaining original contexts: early pre-accept observation if feasible, then fresh exact lease-held inspection and observation before cold mutation. A listener appearing later is a TOCTOU event, not evidence the earlier probe lied. Classify eventual failure only from fresh genuine selected-host evidence; generic Docker command failure stays unconfirmed.

Add one fixed private native bootstrap-history artifact, explicitly approved as bounded boot-diagnostic exception. Suggested closed structure: full admitted scope/owner-enrollment/runtime/release/config/engine binding; latest actually admitted cold attempt generation; optional most recent terminal operation outcome; completion time and fixed validated diagnostic; actual cleanup disposition incomplete/unknown/complete only to the extent observed. No PID/commands/credentials/snapshots/counts/business state.

Mint writer capability only from concrete Run-owned actual service lease and admitted operation, not a caller flag/path/failure. After actual Bootstrap returns, publish terminal result for that exact generation; do not wait for healthy host lifetime to end. A latest-admitted neutral marker may supersede the previous outcome for correlation but is historical acknowledgment, never proof current pending/liveness. If avoiding a marker, explicitly call the record last-completed history and never infer it is latest/current.

Serialize legitimate replacement under service lease, revalidate private enrollment and actual artifact identity, and atomically publish/fsync within reserved budget using held private directory. Compare prior generation+digest+inode, not generation alone. Malformed/mismatched/unknown artifacts remain untouched; boot admission cannot depend on their contents. Enrollment/release/config changes invalidate display and require explicit new namespace/re-enrollment semantics instead of silently overwriting foreign history.

Define retention before code: bounded recent history (suggest24h default), reject future/invalid completion time and binding drift; expired history is unavailable for display, never re-timestamped. Generation cannot prove freshness against malicious same-UID replacement/backup rollback; mark that trust limit rather than inventing cryptographic authority. Valid known old record can be safely superseded via exact compare; unknown replacement cannot.

CLI prioritizes current authenticated NATS status. With unavailable NATS, show current state unknown plus separately labeled prior bootstrap outcome only after fresh local owner/profile authorization. New ensure always does current admission/OSleases/ownership/port checks; historical failure neither starts/stops/adopts nor indefinitely blocks retry. Successful Bootstrap supersedes old failure without native history claiming ready.

Preserve exact cleanup ownership if failed startup leaves partial resources or transferred service lease. Terminal operation failure is not resource reaping proof. Record publisher failure as safe diagnostic-unavailable and preserve its cause/owned descriptor; no hidden success or alternate runtime bus. Once NATS exists, ordinary status/application/agent/federation exchanges continue solely through NATS.
requiredFocusedProof: Actual native Linux/macOS and selected Windows-host listener vs clear/unknown/access cases; WSL-only listener not Windows proof; trusted helper image/closed result/timeout/cleanup refusal.
Known compatible running reuse and two concurrent terminals unchanged; accepted pending within10s even under held bootstrap lease.
Deterministic clear→occupied-before-locked-start race, no shadow instance, genuinely observed momentary cause and preserved unrelated resources.

Actual accepted creator receipt then failed Bootstrap with broker unavailable: same waiting caller and later authorized local status read the exact historical cold outcome, never L04 or currentfailed/ready fabrication.
Success after prior failure and a newer admitted operation with no terminal outcome: old failure does not poison new ensure/current status.

Exact artifact private ACL/nlink/ancestor/directory replacement/generation/digest/enrollment/time/size/unknown-field negatives; old records retained, unknown cannot authorize overwrite/adoption/takeover.
Cleanup-incomplete and publisher I/O failure retain actual handles and original causes; original deadlines unchanged.
Full supported environment and real installed caller/Compose cohort, not helper-only mocks or compile evidence.
limits: No source edits, tests, builds or Docker/provider operations performed.
This is a design revision proposal, not approval of new schema/record/helper/platform trust or a scope reduction. Root owns architecture decision/pattern registration before implementation.

Same-UID trusted plugin model must be explicit. Strong malicious same-UID producer authenticity/rollback resistance would require separately protected signing capability and independent monotonic trust, not stored digests.
Source snapshot matches platform paths; mutable task/document metadata drift is separately recorded rather than silently rebinding historical proposal.
